name: Dead Man's Grasp
description: Seizes an opponent with the unnatural strength of the risen dead: a normal clinch that inflicts lethal (not bashing) damage so long as the Exalt keeps reflexively paying at the start of each turn, and the clinch damage pool grows +1L each full turn maintained (cumulative, resets if he stops paying or relaxes his grip).

name: Rapacious Lamprey Technique
description: Fuels his hunger with Essence, letting the Exalt drink up to Essence×3 health levels of blood in a turn rather than the usual one. Blood loss afflicts the target normally; does not speed devouring flesh.

name: Inescapable Iron Grip
description: Grabs a victim and chokes him silently: a hold attack (adding Essence in automatic successes to the grab) that lets no air in or out. Each maintained turn the victim loses one die from his Strength + Brawl/Martial Arts struggle pool; at zero dice he can no longer struggle, and an Incapacitated victim suffocates as though drowning.

name: Owl Seizes Mouse
description: Surges forward to grab and pin before the foe can respond: a normal clinch or hold that does no damage but forces an immediate reflexive clinch contest as if a subsequent round, and cannot be parried or dodged. The Abyssal may also move up to his sprinting distance without penalty on that turn, clinching beyond his normal reach.

name: Ravaging Strike
description: Channels wrath and Essence through his hands: makes an attack normally but counts extra successes twice for determining damage. May be activated after the attack roll.

name: Scouring Erosion Method

cost.raw: 1 mote per 1 (or 2 for objects) soak reduction

description: A corona of Oblivion reduces the target's soak against this one attack by 1 point per mote (2 points per mote for inanimate objects). Animate targets cannot have their soak reduced below their permanent Essence.

name: Lashing Tempest Attack
description: A cyclone of howling shadows blasts the opponent back two yards per mote spent. A victim thrown into a solid object takes one bashing level per yard not travelled (lethal against spikes or lethal obstructions). Cannot spend more motes than the character's Strength.

name: Bone-Shattering Blow
description: A crushing blow that, if it inflicts at least one level of damage, doubles all the victim's wound penalties until he fully heals; repeated hits add another die of penalty each. UnExalted victims keep the extra penalty until they receive medical treatment to set the broken bones.

name: Five Knife Strike
description: Sprouts wicked bone claws from the fingers, inflicting Strength + 1 lethal damage with all hand-to-hand attacks and letting the character safely parry weapons and other lethal blows.

name: Blood-Drinking Palm
description: A vicious open-handed blow that inflicts lethal damage and siphons blood: the Abyssal regains 1 mote per point of raw damage inflicted before soak (an exception to the usual damage-based feeding rule, capped at the victim's Stamina + Essence per attack). Works only on living beings and Fair Folk, striking bare or cloth-covered skin.

name: Writhing Blood Chain Technique
description: Erupts Essence-worth of razor-clawed blood chains from the character's back and arms, granting that many extra actions per turn (attack or parry only) wielded with Brawl; the chains have Speed/Accuracy/Defense equal to Essence and base Strength + Essence lethal damage. While active the character cannot use Extra Action Charms or benefit from other extra actions, and cannot split his pool on a turn he attacks with the chains.
